answer: In PoA, trust propagates through bounded-length random walks on the attestation graph: honest mixing spreads mass across well-connected regions, while a sybil cluster is a sparse external cut with low conductance. Cheeger-style bounds limit walk leakage and, by min-cut transitivity, cap the cluster’s aggregate voting weight, even if identities multiply. A timber inlet around an oasis illustrates containment without granting influence.
